name: Hospital da Luz (Luz Saude)
verdict: Run by Luz Saúde, 60% owned by the insurer Fidelidade (84.99% Fosun Group, 15% the Portuguese state bank CGD). Nothing found.
note: Portuguese private hospital group; front or sleeve sponsor at several clubs in 2026-27. Rating note: CGD, a bank owned by the Portuguese State, holds 15% of Fidelidade, about 9% of Luz Saúde along the chain, but no record of serious abuses by Portugal is recorded, and state ownership alone is not a tier. Fosun International's substantial shareholders are only Fosun Holdings/Fosun International Holdings (72.78%, owned by Guo Guangchang and Wang Qunbin), so no state holds 5% of it; Fidelidade calls Fosun Group a Chinese private conglomerate. The other 40% of Luz Saúde is held by Macquarie European Infrastructure Fund 7, whose investors aren't sourced.
